entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-05-24
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • JIT: Range check not skipped for 64-bit `x >>> cns` known to be in range #115968
    10.0.0
  • Suggestion: Rename `System.IO.Path.GetDirectoryName` to `System.IO.Path.GetDirectoryPath` for clarity #115965
  • DriveInfo.DriveType returns Unknown for exfat filesystems #115962
  • Should we add System.ThreadingAccessControl to the base shared framework #115961
  • Build android-x64 Release AllSubsets_CoreCLR takes very long time #115955

Closed

  • [API Proposal]: Vector128/256 AddSaturate/RemoveSaturate #82559
    Future
  • Vector{<T>|64|128|256|512}.Narrow with saturation #75724
    Future
  • Unexpected behaviour where code execution suddenly stops #115960
  • Missing GCX_PREEMP_NO_DTOR in PropagateLongJmpThroughNativeFrames #115701
  • [Perf] Linux/arm64: 1 Regression in Perf_HashCode on 11/12/2024 1:47:19 AM #109834
    10.0.0

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix parsing of json with UTF 8 BOM in the host #115967
    area-Host, 10.0.0
  • Improve Math.BigMul on x64 by adding new internal `Multiply` hardware intrinsic to X86Base #115966
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution
  • Fix conditions mismatch for gc-sections with lld #115964
    community-contribution, area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • Added exfat enum entry #115963
    area-System.IO, community-contribution
  • Record exception in HttpClient native instrumentation #115959
    area-System.Net.Http, community-contribution
  • Fix intermittent failures in PAL tests #115958
    area-PAL-coreclr
  • Enable new exception handling on win-x86 #115957
    area-ExceptionHandling-coreclr, community-contribution

Merged

  • Add missing null check for SlhDsa's constructor #115944
    area-System.Security, 10.0.0
  • Disable Android tests in default CI set for now #115956
    area-Infrastructure-coreclr, os-android
  • Added an override for IsCollectible in RuntimeType to fix inconsistency between Mono and CoreCLR #115785
    area-System.Reflection, community-contribution
  • Simplify findvcvarsall.bat #115951
    area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • x86/funclets: Handle longjmp #115932
    area-ExceptionHandling-coreclr, community-contribution

Updated

  • JIT: escape analysis for object fields #115388
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Move GenTreeIntCon::gtCompileTimeHandle field to be a global map #115542
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Add a copilot prompt file for JIT-EE interface modifications #115889
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Fixup how xarch instructions check for embedded broadcast and masking support #115704
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • [RuntimeAsync] ilasm/ildasm support for the MethodImpl.Async (Take 2) #115658
    area-ILTools-coreclr, community-contribution, runtime-async
  • Create copilot-instructions.md #115917
    area-Infrastructure
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 679: Build ID 2716303 #115228
    area-Infrastructure-libraries, linkable-framework
  • [release/10.0-preview5] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #115937
    area-codeflow
  • add HttpMethod.Query #115934
    area-System.Net.Http, community-contribution
  • Convert genRuntimeEventSources to a C# source generator #114810
    area-System.Diagnostics.Tracing
  • [RuntimeAsync] Do not fail EnC on ordinary Task-returning methods when async feature is turned on. #115954
    area-VM-coreclr, runtime-async
  • [TEST] Enable runtime async tests #115947
    NO-MERGE, NO-REVIEW, area-VM-coreclr, runtime-async
  • Ordered evaluation in FileSystemGlobbing Matcher #115940
    area-Extensions-FileSystem
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #115833
    area-codeflow
  • Support out of proc Histogram Base 2 Exponential aggregation #115852
    area-System.Diagnostics.Metric, 10.0.0
  • Remove dead code in R2RPEBuilder #115953
    area-crossgen2-coreclr
  • Option to disallow duplicate JSON properties #115856
    area-System.Text.Json
  • Use UnsafeAccessorType in System.Private.CoreLib and the BCL #115583
